sloka: अशुभाशङ्कि हृदयम् शीलम् च पततीव मे ।श्रुता नो यादृशाः पूर्वम् नृपतीनाम् विनाशने ॥२-७१-३६॥
transliteration: aśubhāśaṅki hṛdayam śīlam ca patatīva me ।śrutā no yādṛśāḥ pūrvam nṛpatīnām vināśane ॥2-71-36॥

translations.english: ﻿ O charioteer I now see the very for ebodings I had heard in the past in connection with the death of kings.
